title: Spot the leak
summary: Match each leaky setup with the fix.

prompts.text: A churn model uses "account closed date is set" as a feature
A demand forecast is evaluated on a random 20% of days from the same year
Training rows get each user's current lifetime spend joined on
A face recogniser has photos of the same people in train and test

options.text: Split by person so test identities are unseen
Remove features derived from the label or its consequences
Split by time: train on the past, test on a later period
Join features as of each event's timestamp
